M: Griddled franks in steamed buns under slow simmered beef chili
Franks griddled, in buns with a loose beef chilli (mince, onion, chilli powder, tomato simmered 45 minutes), grated cheddar and onion. Eat over a napkin.
the reception for Her Majesty that Frank ruins

Topside roasted pink and carved thin, with puffed Yorkshire puddings cooked in smoking dripping, crisp roast potatoes and a rich gravy. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with mustard, salt and pepper and roast at 200C until 52C inside, about 60 minutes, then rest 20 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g plain flour and 200ml milk and rest. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in oil at 200C for 45 minutes. Heat 1 tsp dripping in each hole of a 12-hole muffin tin at 220C until smoking, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes. Make gravy from the pan juices with flour and 400ml beef stock.
W: Ninth inning malt and fudge ice cream cups
Vanilla ice cream with warm chocolate fudge and malt

Vanilla ice cream rippled with hot fudge sauce and crushed malted honeycomb, scooped into paper cups with salted peanuts and a wooden spoon. Soften 1 litre vanilla ice cream for 10 minutes. Heat 100ml cream until steaming and stir in 100g dark chocolate and 1 tbsp golden syrup until smooth, then cool. Ripple half the fudge through the ice cream with 80g crushed chocolate honeycomb and refreeze 1 hour. Scoop into 4 paper cups, spoon over the rest of the warm fudge and scatter with salted peanuts.
K: Fresh lemon juice, sugar and vodka blitzed with ice into a frozen lemonade, served in plastic cups with a lemon wheel and a striped straw. Make syrup by dissolving 100g caster sugar in 100ml hot water and cool. Blend the syrup with 150ml fresh lemon juice, 160ml vodka, 200ml cold water and 4 cups of ice for 30 seconds until slushy. Pour into 4 cups, garnish with lemon wheels and serve with straws.

s.note: Peanuts roasted in the shell with salt
s.how: Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss with a teaspoon of fine salt while still hot. Divide between four paper bags and leave an empty bowl for the shells.

s.note: Griddled franks in steamed buns with yellow mustard and sweet relish
s.how: Simmer 8 franks for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns over the pot for 1 minute. Load each with a frank, yellow mustard and sweet relish and wrap in paper like the ballpark.

m.note: Griddled franks in steamed buns under slow simmered beef chili
m.how: Brown 400g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 tsp chilli powder, add 1 tin tomatoes and simmer 45 minutes. Griddle 8 franks. Put in steamed buns, spoon over chilli and top with 100g grated cheddar and diced onion.
